cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Affectionate Resentment
cards.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tea, love. Leave the bag in for another minute; some things suffer when you forget the date, others when you forget the time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've brought your birthday cake. A month late, I know.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Use the cake knife, not that bread knife. I'll warm the plates while you find it; your first attempt at my birthday deserves proper equipment.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't find it. Can we just cut the cake?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Top drawer, love, beside the candles. Please look before declaring defeat. I've managed to find everything for your last twelve birthdays.
